'''Ariarch-17''' was a [[Star/Legends|sun]] that had gone [[Nova/Legends|nova]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] reign. The cruise ship [[Stardust (transport)|''Stardust'']] made a special trip to witness the nova, though the captain miscalculated the force of the nova, resulting in the death of many of his passengers.
